Context: 2. Determination of Relative Seniority

- 2.3. Supreme Court Order.Starting from Nov.ember 19, 201.9, the inter se seniority of direct recruits and prornotees is governed by the principles outlined in the order of the Hon'ble-Suprerne Court of India in the K. Meghachandra Singh case. These principles include the deter.mination of seniority based on the year of appointment and the delinking of seniority from the year of vacancy.
